statement: E_k(r) + E_k(c) - P_k(A) <= 2 - k!/n^k on K_n, equality only at J_n/n
gram_basis_note: basis[u] is a monomial in the variables b_0..b_{N-1}, given as a list of variable indices with repetition; variable u corresponds to matrix position (u // n, u % n).  The constant monomial is EXCLUDED, so every sigma vanishes at b = 0 automatically
identity: F(b) = sum_uv G0[u][v] m_u m_v + sum_p (1/n + b_p) sum_uv Gp[p][u][v] m_u m_v + lam(b) * sum_q b_q, where m_u is the monomial basis[u]
